description: A retain job that downloads artifacts is rejected.

patches.replace:
- task: DownloadPipelineArtifact@2
            inputs:
              buildType: current
              artifactName: release-manifest
              targetPath: $(Pipeline.Workspace)/release-manifest
            target:
              commands: restricted
              settableVariables: none
          - bash: bash "$PIPELINE_WORKSPACE/s/core/pipelines/azure-devops/scripts/retain.sh"
